description: Run online password attacks against live services with hydra and its alternatives (medusa, ncrack, patator, crowbar) — service modules, http-post-form failure strings, thread tuning, resume, and lockout avoidance. Load when scope allows credential guessing against SSH/FTP/RDP/MySQL/web login forms and offline cracking is not an option. Signals: hydra -l -P, http-post-form, ^USER^ ^PASS^, ssh:// rdp:// mysql:// targets, medusa -M, ncrack, patator, login brute force.
